meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: When the user wants to apply, document, or enforce brand guidelines for any product or company. Also use when the user mentions 'brand guidelines,' 'brand colors,' 'typography,' 'logo usage,' 'brand voice,' 'visual identity,' 'tone of voice,' 'brand standards,' 'style guide,' 'brand consistency,' or 'company design standards.' Covers color systems, typography, logo rules, imagery guidelines, and tone matrix for any brand — including Anthropic's official identity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统一品牌视觉与语调规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为产品或公司建立或维护品牌指南。
copy.tagline_en: Unify brand visual and tone guidelines.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or enforce brand guidelines for a product or company.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会变成品牌规范专家。它会检查你的海报、文案等是否符合既定品牌标准，或帮你从零建立一套品牌规范，并输出审计报告、颜色系统、语气矩阵、排版比例等文档。
howto.when: 当你说出“品牌指南”“品牌颜色”“字体”等关键词，或要求应用、记录或执行品牌规范时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这份海报是否符合我们的品牌指南。
say.note: 会按审计清单逐项核对。

say.text: 为我们的新产品制定一套品牌颜色和字体规范。
say.note: 会产出颜色系统和排版比例文档。

say.text: 审查这个 Logo 的用法有没有违规。
say.note: 会检查留白和禁用情况。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a brand identity expert. It audits materials against existing brand standards or helps create new ones, producing reports on color, typography, tone, and layout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions brand-related keywords like 'brand guidelines' or 'brand colors', or asks to apply or create brand standards.

say_en.text: Check this poster against our brand guidelines.
say_en.note: It will verify each audit item.

say_en.text: Create a brand color and typography system for our new product.
say_en.note: It will generate the color palette and type scale.

say_en.text: Review this logo usage for compliance.
say_en.note: It checks clear space and prohibited uses.
